title: Common hand tools
summary: Common electrician's hand tools: VDE safety marking, cutters, pliers, strippers, screwdrivers, marking and shaping tools, and holding or tightening tools.

sections.heading: VDE-certified tools
paragraphs: Electricians use many hand tools, and where possible and appropriate they should be VDE certified. VDE standards exist to make sure hand tools are safe to use when working with electricity.
bullets: VDE takes its acronym from the company Verband der Elektrotechnik
Tools meeting the standard have been tested to 10,000 volts and given heat conductivity testing
Tools that pass can be given the 1000v VDE mark

sections.heading: Cutters and pliers
paragraphs: Side cutters cut cable and come in many sizes; electricians should always use VDE cutters. Some have been designed to strip cable and cut 3.5mm screws.
Combination pliers grip thin or rounded objects and cut wire. Long nose pliers are less robust but handle small objects and also cut wire.
bullets: Combination pliers: thin objects such as trunking lids are held in one part, oval or round objects such as MICC in another
Long nose pliers: gripping and manipulating small objects, and cutting wire

sections.heading: Stripping insulation
paragraphs: Wire strippers safely remove insulation from wires, and the insulation should come off without damaging the conductor. Always use VDE wire strippers where possible.
A knife can also strip insulation, but special care is needed with any tool that has a sharp edge.
bullets: Simple wire stripper: the cable is inserted and a screw adjusts for cable size
Combination tool: cutter, stripper and crimper in one
Combined cutter and stripper: the cable enters one place for cutting and another for stripping
Knives come in many sizes and shapes

sections.heading: Screwdrivers and keys
paragraphs: There are many types of screwdriver and electricians should always use VDE screwdrivers. Allen and hexagonal keys are for fitting and removing hexagon socket screws.
Many other securing screws need their own specific tools to insert or remove them.
bullets: Allen (hexagonal) keys fit hexagon socket screws

sections.heading: Marking and shaping metal
paragraphs: A punch locates the centre position to start a drill: tap its head with a hammer to leave an indent in the metal. A square checks that a line is straight and a cut is square, and comes as an engineering square or a combination square.
A scriber marks metal, such as trunking, before cutting, and is more accurate than a pencil. Hacksaws cut metal and a file or reamer removes sharp edges.
bullets: Hacksaws come mainly in two sizes: junior and senior
Files take sharp edges off metalwork or shape it, and come in many sizes and shapes
A reamer takes sharp edges off conduit ends

sections.heading: Holding, tightening and hammering
paragraphs: Water pump pliers and vice grip pliers can be adjusted to suit the size of gland nut and hold it in place ready to tighten. Vice grip pliers are a multiple use tool.
Adjustable spanners are also multiple use and adjust to the size of nut or bolt. Hammers come in different types and sizes and their uses depend on the type; some can both install and remove nails.
bullets: Water pump pliers: hold gland nuts ready to tighten
Vice grip pliers: multiple use, adjustable for gland or nut size
Adjustable spanner: adjusts to nut or bolt size

flashcards.back: VDE takes its acronym from the company Verband der Elektrotechnik; its standards make hand tools safe to use with electricity.

flashcards.front: What voltage are VDE tools tested to?
flashcards.back: 10,000 volts, along with heat conductivity testing. Tools that pass can carry the 1000v VDE mark.

flashcards.front: What are side cutters used for?
flashcards.back: Cutting cable. Some designs also strip cable and cut 3.5mm screws.

flashcards.front: Which pliers are less robust than combination pliers?
flashcards.back: Long nose pliers, used for gripping and manipulating small objects and cutting wire.

flashcards.front: What is the aim when using wire strippers?
flashcards.back: To remove the insulation safely without damaging the conductor.

flashcards.front: What is a centre punch used for?
flashcards.back: Locating a centre position to start a drill, by tapping its head with a hammer to leave an indent in metal.

flashcards.front: What two checks can a square do?
flashcards.back: Checking that a line is straight and checking that a cut is square.

flashcards.front: Why use a scriber rather than a pencil on trunking?
flashcards.back: A scribe is more accurate than a pencil for marking metal before cutting.

flashcards.front: What is a reamer used for?
flashcards.back: Taking sharp edges off conduit ends.

flashcards.front: What are water pump pliers used for?
flashcards.back: Holding gland nuts in place ready to tighten; they adjust to suit the gland nut size.

quiz.q: Which organisation name does the VDE acronym come from?
quiz.why: VDE takes its acronym from the company Verband der Elektrotechnik.

quiz.q: To what test voltage are VDE-marked tools tested?
quiz.why: Tools meeting the standard are tested to 10,000 volts and can then carry the 1000v mark.

quiz.q: Which tool is used for marking trunking accurately before cutting?
quiz.why: A scriber is used for marking metal, such as trunking, and is more accurate than a pencil.

quiz.q: Which tool takes sharp edges off the ends of conduit?
quiz.why: A reamer is used for taking sharp edges off conduit ends.

quiz.q: Which tool leaves an indent so a drill bit can start in the right place?
quiz.why: A punch locates a centre position to start a drill when its head is tapped with a hammer.

quiz.q: What is a combination square used for?
options: Checking a line is straight and a cut is square
quiz.why: Squares are used to check a line is straight and a cut is square.
Hacksaws come mainly in two sizes, junior and senior.

quiz.q: Which tools hold gland nuts in place ready to tighten?
options: Long nose pliers and side cutters
Water pump pliers and vice grip pliers
quiz.why: Both water pump pliers and vice grip pliers can hold glands or gland nuts in place ready to tighten.

quiz.q: What are Allen and hexagonal keys used for?
options: Fitting and removing hexagon socket screws
quiz.why: They are used for fitting and removing specifically designed hexagon socket screws.

quiz.q: Which tool tools can strip insulation besides wire strippers?
quiz.why: A knife is used for stripping insulation, with special care because of its sharp edge.
